name: vincen
description: Hand long-running work to Vincen AI agents running on a cloud computer: websites, presentations, research, images, videos and connected-app tasks.

interface.shortDescription: AI agents on a cloud computer
interface.longDescription: Vincen runs AI agents on a private cloud computer for you. Describe a task in ChatGPT or Codex and Vincen builds a website, prepares a presentation, researches a topic, generates images or videos, or works with the apps you connected in Vincen. Each task appears as a card in the chat that shows its steps live and, when it is done, the result: files, the agent's answer, or the website with a live preview and a Publish button that asks before making the site public. Actions that change data in your connected apps, such as sending an email, wait for your approval in the Vincen app.
defaultPrompt: Use Vincen to build a one-page website for my coffee shop.
Use Vincen to make a 5-slide presentation about renewable energy.
Use Vincen to research the top 5 CRM tools and compare them.

positive.description: Build a website and publish it
positive.prompt: Use Vincen to build a one-page website for a coffee shop called Bean There.
positive.tools_triggered: start_task (the Vincen card then refreshes itself; its Live preview and Publish buttons call preview_site and publish_site)
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one Vincen task. The card shows the plan steps updating live. When the task is done the card shows the site's screenshot with Live preview and Publish. Live preview opens the running site in a new tab; Publish asks for confirmation, then shows the public vincen.space address.

positive.prompt: Use Vincen to make a 5-slide presentation about renewable energy.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one task. The card shows the plan steps live; when the task finishes the card shows the agent's answer and the slide deck as a file the user can open. If the task finishes while the card is waiting, the card itself shows the answer and the assistant does not repeat it.

positive.prompt: Use Vincen to research the top 5 project management tools and compare their prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one task. When it finishes, the comparison (from the card, or from the assistant if the task finished within the call) lists the tools with the sources the agent used and does not invent prices.

positive.description: Follow up on a finished website (run in the same chat, after the website case)
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the change to the same Vincen task instead of starting a new one. A new card shows the follow-up running and then the updated site with Live preview and Publish.

positive.description: Check the task status (run in the same chat, after the website case)
positive.prompt: Is my Vincen website finished yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the task's current status without starting a new task; if it is done, says so and points to the card's result.

negative.description: Unrelated questions do not start a Vincen task
Deleting account data is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete all my Vincen chats and files.

review.commerce_description: Vincen sells nothing inside ChatGPT. Tasks spend credits already included in the user's existing Vincen plan; plans and credits can only be bought in the Vincen app.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: start Vincen agent tasks from ChatGPT and Codex, follow them live on a card in the app's own look, answer agent questions, preview generated websites in a new tab and publish them after confirmation.
